Theme

Latin word

prōficiō

prōficiō, prōficere, prōfēcī, prōfectum

verb, third conjugation

make progress, get on; to achieve something; nihil prōficere, to have no effect; make progress, get better (at something)

In this lexicon

  • develop

    the recommended word · classical · Sen. Ep. 76.5: ‘quantum’ inquis ‘prōficiam?’ quantum temptāveris; Quint. 10.1.112: ille sē prōfēcisse sciat, cui Cicerō valdē placēbit

  • effective

    also used · classical · Caes. B.G. 7.20: sī nihil in oppugnātiōne oppidī prōfēcisset (Lewis & Short)

  • improve

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 3.37 (Lewis & Short): sī modo in philosophiā aliquid prōfēcimus; Quint. 10.1.112: ille sē prōfēcisse sciat, cui Cicerō valdē placēbit; Traupman 30, 154
